text_block_list.text:
The Make Debut. Agnes Digital ran through her crucial
first race with flying colors. And then—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
............
The origin... and the pinnacle...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The origin and the pinnacle... The gates opening for the first time, the unfamiliar sense of distance, the tangled legs...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Sweat flew, and panic made everything go blank.
Eventually the cheers faded, leaving only
the results on the electronic board..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That was way too emotional! Everything about it
was just so, so touching! Right, right, right!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, getting jostled all around by those beginner
Umamusume girls running with all their might, I..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I totally underestimated the Make Debut, huh!
Everyone's a winner! Literally everyone!

Agnes Digital looked overjoyed to be able to run
alongside the fresh, youthful Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And Trainer-san, today's race
is still only just the beginning, right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So there are tons of Umamusume cuties
waiting for me just up ahead, right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"It's just the absolute peak! I've stepped right through the gates of paradise!
I've completely crossed over!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If it's come to this, turf or dirt, all we can do is push,
push, and keep pushing! Here we go again!
choice_data_list: Does that mean a turf race is next?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, that's right.
Today was dirt, so next is turf...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, no, octopus-headed Digi-tan!
Let us think about this a bit more prudently."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I see, I see. Today's situation of making a debut was just far too intense... That's why everything else completely flew out of my head~

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I wanna see more Umamusume-chan frolicking in the sand!
So, can I get another serving of dirt races, please?

After our discussion, we decided that her next race
would be the "Hyacinth Stakes" in the new year.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Next year... That's still a little while away. In that case,
running in various races until then might be...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let's build up good karma. Because I want to get to know so many more Uma Musume deeply.
Completely one-sidedly, of course.

The Twinkle Series has only just begun.
Let's expand our knowledge and deepen our bonds
leading up to the Hyacinth Stakes.
